definitions.explanation: The branch of physics that deals with the motion of objects and the forces acting on them.
Used figuratively to describe the interplay of forces or power relationships in social, political, or organizational contexts.

notes:
A compound of {力|りき} (force, power) and ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (study, science). In academic contexts, refers to the physics discipline. In media and commentary, the figurative sense of "dynamics" or "power dynamics" is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {量子|りょうし}{力学|りきがく}: quantum mechanics
- ⟦{古典|こてん}→古典：00242_koten⟧{力学|りきがく}: classical mechanics
- {流体|りゅうたい}{力学|りきがく}: fluid dynamics
- {熱|ねつ}{力学|りきがく}: thermodynamics
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力学|りきがく}: political dynamics
- {力学|りきがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: dynamics are at work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧: physics — the broader discipline
- ダイナミクス: dynamics — the loanword, used in business and social contexts
- ⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: power relationship — more concrete than the abstract {力学|りきがく}
